title: At a local complete intersection point the conormal module is free of rank n minus the dimension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $n\ge0$, $P=k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], $I\subseteq P$ an ideal, $S=P/I$ and $\mathfrak q\subset S$ a prime ideal. Assume there is $g\in S\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that the localization $S_g$ is a global complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Let $d=\dim_{\mathfrak q}(\operatorname{Spec}S)$ be the Krull dimension of the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] at the point $\mathfrak q$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]. Then $d$ is an integer with $0\le d\le n$, and the localization $(I/I^2)_{\mathfrak q}$ of the $S$-module $I/I^2$ at $S\setminus\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is a free $S_{\mathfrak q}$-module [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] of rank $n-d$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC (label lemma-lci, line 35909), implication (1) => (4), with c = height(q') - height(q) = n - dim_q(S) as in its statement (Lemma 00P2 lemma-codimension, line 28270, and dim_x A^n = n, Lemma 00OT and lemma-dim-affine-space); proof: last paragraph of the proof of 00SC (regular sequence of length t in k[y]_{q''}, J/J^2 free, Lemma 00S6 lemma-conormal-module-localize)
